title: A touched cheek turns a newborn's head toward a nipple
summary: MedlinePlus says a newborn turns the head toward a touch on the cheek and sucks when a nipple meets the lips.
body: On the MedlinePlus infant page, rooting and sucking are one primitive reflex. The infant turns the head in search of a nipple when the cheek is touched, and begins to suck when the nipple touches the lips. The page lists this with other early reflexes in the newborn to 2 month span. This card is that search-and-suck pairing. It does not set a feeding schedule, and it is not advice for one infant.
